William Harvey démontre que le cœur fait: William Harvey shows that the heart pumps blood around in a loop.
Il calcule que le cœur pompe en une heur: He calculates that in one hour the heart pumps more blood than the body contains: so it must come back. His theory was mocked for a long time.
The Beagle stops at the Galápagos.
Darwin y collecte des pinsons sans noter: Darwin collects finches there without noting which island they come from. It was the ornithologist John Gould who, in London, noticed they were all different.
Schleiden et Schwann montrent que plante: Schleiden and Schwann show that plants and animals are made of cells.
Theodor Schwann et Matthias Schleiden gé: Theodor Schwann and Matthias Schleiden generalize the idea; Rudolf Virchow adds in 1855 that every cell comes from another cell.
À Vienne, Ignace Semmelweis impose aux m: In Vienna, Ignaz Semmelweis makes doctors wash their hands with chlorine.
La mortalité des accouchées de son servi: Mortality among women giving birth on his ward drops from about 10% to about 1%. His colleagues, offended at being accused of spreading death, reject him. He died in an asylum in 1865, before Pasteur and Lister proved him right.
Ernst Haeckel nomme la science des relat: Ernst Haeckel names the science of the relationships between living beings and their environment.
Haeckel, grand diffuseur de Darwin en Al: Haeckel, Darwin's great popularizer in Germany, was also a prodigious draftsman: his Art Forms in Nature inspired Art Nouveau.
De Vries, Correns et Tschermak redécouvr: De Vries, Correns and Tschermak rediscover Mendel's work.
Hugo de Vries, Carl Correns et Erich von: Hugo de Vries, Carl Correns and Erich von Tschermak reach the same results and discover that a monk had published them 34 years earlier.
Fleming remarque une moisissure qui tue: Fleming notices a mold that kills bacteria.
Il faudra attendre Howard Florey et Erns: It took Howard Florey and Ernst Chain, around 1940, to turn it into a drug produced in quantity.
Charpentier et Doudna décrivent des cise: Charpentier and Doudna describe programmable molecular scissors.
Leur article de juin 2012 dans Science l: Their June 2012 paper in Science launched a revolution in genome editing. Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2020, the first science Nobel awarded to two women alone.
